##### Project general facts

Havelock Residences is a contemporary residential development located in Discovery Gardens, offering a refined collection of studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. The architecture is defined by a modern aesthetic with clean lines and expansive glass façades that maximise natural light and create a bright, open living environment. Thoughtfully designed balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, offering private views over the community while enhancing comfort and functionality. The building is strategically positioned to provide seamless access to transport links, retail, and dining destinations, ensuring everyday convenience for residents.

The development offers a vibrant and active lifestyle supported by a wide range of leisure and recreational amenities designed for all age groups. Residents can enjoy a beach-style swimming pool, aqua gym, outdoor cinema, skate park, and basketball court, creating a dynamic environment that encourages both relaxation and activity. Families benefit from dedicated indoor and outdoor children’s play areas, while additional facilities such as the clubhouse and gaming arena provide engaging spaces for social interaction and community living.

Inside, Havelock Residences features modern interiors finished with high-quality materials that enhance both durability and aesthetic appeal. The apartments are designed with practical layouts and a clean contemporary style, ensuring comfort and ease of living throughout. Kitchens come fully equipped with appliances, offering convenience for everyday use. The residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalise their interiors according to their own taste and lifestyle preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Discovery Gardens is a vibrant residential community located near Al Furjan in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Offering a mix of affordable apartments and townhouses, Discovery Gardens is designed to provide a comfortable and convenient lifestyle for its residents.

The community is characterized by its beautifully landscaped gardens, creating a serene and peaceful environment. With various clusters featuring distinct architectural styles, Discovery Gardens offers a diverse range of living options to suit different preferences. Residents can enjoy a host of amenities, including swimming pools, playgrounds, sports facilities, and retail outlets, making it a self-sufficient and lively community.

Located close to Al Furjan, Discovery Gardens provides easy access to major roads, public transportation, and essential services, enhancing its appeal as a well-connected and accessible living destination. Whether you're a young professional, a family, or an investor seeking a promising opportunity, Discovery Gardens offers a delightful living experience in the heart of Dubai's thriving landscape.
